---
title: Activation Tracker
description: Track ramp-up of recently approved B2C vendors — stage, coverage, credits, orders, time to first pickup, and what is blocking them.
---

## Overview

**Sidebar:** Vendors → Roster → **Activation Tracker** (`/vendors/activation`). Page title: **Vendor Activation** — "Ramp progress for recently approved vendors, and what's blocking the ones that haven't started."

Use it after accepting vendors in [New Applications](/new-vendors---b2c) to make sure each one actually starts receiving and completing orders.

## KPI cards

| Card | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| Approved in window | Vendors approved within the selected window. |
| Blocked | Approved vendors that cannot receive orders yet. |
| Ready · no orders | Covered and funded, but no orders have reached them yet. |
| Ramping | Have started receiving orders. |
| Median days to 1st pickup | Median days from approval to first completed pickup. |

## Filters

- **Window** — 30d, 60d (default), 90d, 180d.
- **Stage** — All, Blocked, Ready · no orders, Ramping, Active.
- **Refresh** — reloads the data.

## Table

| Column | What it shows |
| --- | --- |
| Vendor | Vendor name. |
| City | Vendor city. |
| Stage | Blocked, Ready · no orders, Ramping or Active. |
| Since approval | Days since approval. |
| Pincodes | Number of pincodes assigned. |
| Credits | Current credit balance. |
| Orders | Orders completed / received. |
| 1st pickup | Days from approval to first pickup ("—" if none yet). |
| Next step | What to do next, e.g. "Covered and funded, but no orders have reached them yet". |

<Callout kind="info">

Approval dates are read from the vendor status-change log. The footer shows when the data was last updated.

</Callout>

<Callout kind="tip">

For a **Blocked** vendor, open them in [All Vendors](/b2c-vendors) and check pincodes / zones, Max Leads and credits — a vendor needs at least one pincode and Max Leads above 0 to go Live.

</Callout>
